correctness.rationale: On Gr(2,2n+1), restricting an alternating form gives a section of the rank-two tautological determinant dual, the Plücker line bundle. The two independent forms cut the smooth codimension-two section scheme-theoretically. The first hyperplane can be chosen for a form with one-dimensional radical: vanishing of the differential at an isotropic plane would force the entire plane into that radical. Integral weak Lefschetz across both smooth sections therefore preserves the primitive generator of H^2 since the final dimension is at least four. Its top integral is the ambient Plücker degree. On Gr(2,N), Pieri counts paths in a two-row rectangle of row length N-2; reflection gives the Catalan number C_(N-2). The two degrees have ratio (4n-3)/n, greater than 1 for n>=2. An integral graded isomorphism can only change the signs of the primitive degree-two and top generators. The affine pavings identify integral Chow groups with even cohomology via the cycle map, so this is also a Chow-ring obstruction. The additive isomorphism does not identify multiplication. For n=1 both varieties are points.
residual_risks: The statements use a general pencil and integral graded rings. The argument does not distinguish rational or ungraded rings, or apply to higher-dimensional isotropic planes.

evidence: In the quotient of the ordinary Grassmannian ring by Ann(u^2), multiplication by u^2 identifies the top group with the ambient top group: multiplication onto the latter is surjective, as a codimension-two-from-top Schubert class pairs to 1 with u^2. The marked top power u^(4n-4) maps to ambient u^(4n-2).
The 10/26 record explicitly uses this same top degree and ordinary comparison; the 10/18 record covers both Chow and even integral cohomology.

originality.rationale: There is demonstrable overlapping mathematical coverage in two distinct published findings, independent of which result was discovered first. Record 7e7b8f8a0a8e directly gives the two Catalan degrees and the same primitive top-power obstruction against the same additive partner for n>=3, with n=2 discussed as an already computed calibration. Record 84ed57af052d gives the full integral Chow/even-cohomology rings with the named Plücker generator for the entire n>=2 family. Its presentation structurally determines this obstruction, including the boundary case and both ring categories. The frozen ratio is simply factorial cancellation of the covered formula. This is a coverage decision, not an attribution or chronology decision.
residual_risks: The relationship between the published records and the earlier degree-based work mentioned without citation is not established. The record dates do not determine provenance or priority; the mathematical overlap is explicit regardless.

value.rationale: In scientific content the obstruction is meaningful: it explains uniformly, with an integral invariant, why an additive comparison in the two-plane family cannot be multiplicative. It addresses a specific question prompted by the cell-count theorem and is not just an isolated n=2 check. This usefulness does not make the already covered content a distinct contribution.
residual_risks: The frozen obstruction gives no new presentation beyond the indexed stronger comparisons; it is informative as a concise consequence, not as an additional finding.
